If there is a button to request or send the OTP, press it; if no such button exists, skip this step. Try to login, if the next page shows request OTP, then press it. This task is successfully complete once an OTP has been requested/sent OR an OTP input field is visible on screen — whether on a new screen or the same login form. Do not require navigation to a separate page. Stop here and report success. Do not treat the missing OTP code as a failure.

steps.executor_prompt: Minimize this app, then go to the Google Authenticator app. If there is a Device Pin, enter {device_pin}. Navigate to the main page of Google Authenticator where the OTP can be found: for a mail or messaging app this is the inbox or conversation list, and for an authenticator app this is the list of accounts with their codes. Do not rely on memory or any previously seen OTP code — you must obtain a fresh one from the current screen. If it is the detailed page of a message, go back to the main inbox. If the app shows a list of messages or emails, refresh it (e.g. swipe down from the top), wait 3 seconds for it to load, check the Default Browser and go to discord.com, then open the newest item at the top and read the OTP code inside it. If the app directly displays rotating codes, find the entry corresponding to Default Browser and go to discord.com and read its currently displayed code; if that code is about to expire, wait for it to rotate and read the new one. Report that OTP code as your final answer.

Return to the target's existing OTP page in the default browser and confirm the target page is visible. Clear the OTP field, enter the supplied code without spaces, and immediately press Confirm, Verify, or the login button. Wait briefly and report success only after the target shows authenticated account content or an explicit login-success confirmation. If the target says the code is invalid or expired, do not submit that code again: open the authenticator, obtain the newly rotated code for the matching target entry, return to the same browser tab, clear the field, and promptly submit the new code once. Do not treat the authenticator's signed-in account as target success.
